goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: User-facing claim: Type, Select, Drag, and Hold are simple canvas-first cues with durable editor/CLI parity and native deterministic CSS. Most T004 defects are corrected, but the claim still fails: the editor creates only two-point Drags and silently discards CLI-authored intermediate arrivals on edit; the purported keyboard proof uses Playwright selectOption rather than keyboard input; multi-target Hold canvas picking replaces prior choices; and boundary proof establishes repeatability without proving each transition’s expected state. These are material canvas, metadata-preservation, accessibility, and proof gaps. Geometry, Hold playback metadata, Type restriction/layout, reduced motion, diagnostics, deterministic receipts, privacy, and phase containment now pass.
evidence: T004 canvas disposition — partially corrected: apps/editor/src/main.ts:414-420 and 1517-1552 enable canvas target picking, while apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:52-89 exercises mouse selection and a canvas path drag.

Remaining P1 Drag canvas/authority defect — apps/editor/src/main.ts:1278-1284 always reconstructs Drag with exactly start/end waypoints; hydrateCueForm at 1369-1376 loads only first/last. Therefore the unified canvas cannot create the goal-required intermediate arrival, and editing a CLI-authored three-point Drag silently deletes its middle waypoint. Domain support is proven by packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.test.ts:213-239, making the editor loss directly observable rather than a schema limitation.

Remaining P2 Hold canvas defect — renderReusableTargetOverlay at apps/editor/src/main.ts:1538-1542 handles a multiple select by setting only the clicked option selected and clearing all others. The Motion targets canvas control therefore cannot accumulate the ordered multi-target scope represented by Hold semantics.

Remaining P2 keyboard-proof defect — apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:78-81 calls focus() and Playwright selectOption(); it sends no keyboard events and does not prove the advertised keyboard fallback. The wide/narrow transition has no responsive containment or reachability assertion.

T004 Drag geometry disposition — corrected: packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:239-261 emits deterministic zero-origin left/top tracks and coordinated transforms; visual proof measured the stored grip delta at 6.4/-7.2 CSS pixels.

T004 Hold disposition — corrected: packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:385-409 preserves delay, binding override, iteration count, direction, fill mode, play state, timing function, and keyframe data. Focused metadata and missing-enter-boundary tests pass.

T004 Type disposition — corrected: cueTargetSnapshots and validation require contentKind=text; the editor exposes reusableTextTargetOptions only; clip-path reveal leaves the final computed width at 80px in Chrome.
T004 reduced-motion disposition — corrected: packages/local-service/src/seed.ts:70-72 disables animation for the reusable scene, and installed Chrome reports reducedAnimationCount=0.

T004 visual-proof disposition — improved but incomplete: the test samples 29 t-1/t/t+1 times, obtains two identical raster-hash runs with zero repeated pixel drift, and checks grip geometry. However packages/visual-proof/src/reusable-cues.visual.test.ts:80-88 asserts only global distinct-value counts plus one Hold equality; it would still pass if individual Type steps or Drag press/release boundaries were wrong. No per-boundary expected-state/delta map is emitted.

T004 receipt and diagnostics disposition — corrected: the installed-Chrome receipt is path- and timestamp-free and contains canonical/export/compiler digests, cue and diagnostic counts, a visual aggregate digest, and command status. Chrome asserts positive native CSSAnimation inventory and zero console, page, HTTP, failed-request, and unexpected-network errors.

T004 claim/history disposition — substantially corrected: installed Chrome exercises a claimed agent update, unauthorized and stale rejection, durable reload, and detach/delete/undo/redo for every family while preserving compiled bytes. The remaining intermediate-waypoint deletion prevents complete metadata/history confidence.

Independent verification passed: installed-Chrome browser workflow 1/1; visual proof 1/1; focused domain/protocol/CLI suites 30/30; git diff --check; protected-file diff; sensitive scan findingCount=0 across tracked/diff/index/worktree/untracked; private-ignore targetCount=3, ignoredCount=3, trackedPrivateCount=0.

Failure mode 1, cue/track drift and editor/CLI divergence — FAIL: editor hydration/resubmission deletes an intermediate Drag waypoint created through the CLI. Hold metadata and per-family detach/history otherwise pass.

Failure mode 2, hidden/missing canvas behavior or incorrect native boundaries — FAIL: intermediate arrival authoring, multi-target Hold canvas selection, genuine keyboard operation, responsive assertions, and per-boundary expected-state proof remain incomplete; fixed-grip geometry and native CSS rendering pass.

Failure mode 3, leakage or masked runtime failures — PASS: sensitive/private scans, named-subdomain Chrome, reduced motion, positive animation inventory, complete browser diagnostics, deterministic receipts, and phase-containment inspection passed.

parallel_safety.reason: The correction couples Drag semantic hydration/submission, shared canvas controls, browser interaction proof, and visual receipt assertions. Separate writers could make UI semantics and proof disagree.

missing_evidence: Create and adjust a Drag with at least one intermediate arrival entirely through the unified canvas, then edit/reload/undo without losing any waypoint.
Genuine keyboard-only target selection and responsive containment/reachability at wide and narrow viewports.
Canvas accumulation and preservation of multiple Hold targets, or an explicit contract narrowing Hold to one target.
Per-boundary expected-state or expected-delta assertions and sanitized aggregates for every Type step and Select, Drag, and Hold boundary.
required_board_updates: Insert one bounded corrective Worker before T005. Objective: preserve and author intermediate Drag arrivals on canvas, make reusable multi-target picking additive, prove real keyboard/responsive operation, and strengthen boundary proof without changing cue/domain/compiler architecture.

Corrective verify: create a three-waypoint Drag from the editor; drag its middle point; edit timing without waypoint loss; reload and exact undo/redo; round-trip an equivalent CLI Drag; select multiple Hold targets on canvas; operate fallback selects using keyboard events at wide and narrow viewports with containment assertions; assert expected state/delta at every t-1/t/t+1 boundary; run installed Chrome twice and require byte-identical sanitized receipts; rerun focused suites, sensitive/private scans, protected-file diff, and git diff --check.

Corrective stop_if: a domain/protocol/compiler change is required; intermediate arrivals cannot remain explicit versioned cue data; fixing proof requires a second runtime/interpolator; legacy cue bytes change; private material or later-phase scope is required; or any file outside the corrective allowlist is needed.
After correction, rerun this Judge gate before activating T005.
